jobs.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Nature of work completed in the job:

Orchestrates program execution collaborating with top vehicle manufacturers, ensuring full alignment and meeting expectations
Manages cross-functional teams to deliver multiple related projects on schedule, focusing on quality and following company strategy
Facilitates effective communication between stakeholders to drive successful outcomes and maintain strong relationships with the manufacturers and other different players in the industry

Contribution Level:

Fosters cross functional collaboration with Keyloop stakeholders
Builds and maintains positive relationships with manufacturers and other key players
Contributes to expand and accelerate Keyloop product and strategy vision; from OEM certifications to full journey ecosystems

Provides regular updates and reports on program status to senior management and stakeholders.

Familiarity and exposure to Generative AI technologies and their application to project management is a plus
Technical:

High level understanding of the automotive industry, including trends and best practices
Knowledge of OEM sales and aftersales journeys

Skill to analyze complex problems and make informed decisions under uncertainty scenarios
Capacity to anticipate to potential challenges, evaluating alternatives and proactively addressing them before they escalate
Relationship Focus:
Strong communication skills to deliver program status, updates and risks to internal and external stakeholders
Facility to build and maintain positive relationships with manufacturers and other key stakeholders
Ability to address customer needs promptly and effectively, meeting expectations and ensuring high levels of satisfaction

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. jobs.title: Program Manager, State & Enterprise Programs
jobs.description:
About Wonderschool

Wonderschool is the operating system for child care in America. State governments and large enterprises partner with us to run child care licensing, subsidy programs, and provider and family search on our platform. We are growing fast, and every new state or enterprise win becomes a complex, high-stakes delivery engagement.

The Role

We need a Program Manager to run our state and enterprise engagements. You will own the delivery plan, the client relationship, and the coordination between our clients and our product and engineering teams, across every active project. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time in project plans, client meetings, spreadsheets of acceptance criteria, and hard conversations about dates.

You are the person who makes sure what we promise to government and enterprise clients is what gets delivered, on time, on contract, with the paper trail to prove it.

Responsibilities

Own the delivery plan for each engagement across all workstreams. Track milestones, UAT cycles, and acceptance against each contracted statement of work.
Run the client cadence on every project: weekly status, steering meetings, escalations, and working sessions with agency program staff, legal, and state IT.
Keep dependency registers current. Clients owe us integration specs, test environments, credentials, data feeds, and business decisions on a schedule. Hold both sides to their dates and keep the paper trail that supports excusable-delay and change-order claims.
Manage scope: capability traceability, acceptance criteria negotiation, change requests, and intake of new work.
Produce deliverables for client review and keep Wonderschool leadership ahead of risks across the whole portfolio instead of behind them.
Work with engineering leads on integration timelines with state systems (ERP platforms, state data hubs, SSO). You will not own technical design, but you need to follow the conversation and know when a date is slipping.
Build the repeatable program playbook as we add states and enterprise clients.

Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management on complex software delivery. Government or regulated-industry clients strongly preferred.
You have managed contractual milestones, UAT-based acceptance, and formal change control, and you have the scars to show for it.
You write well. Status reports, meeting summaries, and acceptance criteria language will carry your name.
You can run a plan that depends on teams you do not manage, on both sides of the table.
Strongly preferred: experience with child care programs in state government (licensing, subsidy/CCAP, eligibility, or provider systems).
A plus: state human services or eligibility systems experience, or familiarity with state procurement.

Location and Compensation

Location: Remote. San Francisco preferred for in-person collaboration with the product and engineering team; open to remote candidates anywhere in the US.
Compensation: Competitive market rate plus meaningful equity.
Benefits: Full package (health, dental, vision, 401k, flexible PTO).

jobs.description:
About Us

With over 2.400 employees, Fichtner is Germany’s leading independent planning and consultancy enterprise. We are global players and tackle challenging projects in more than 100 countries. Among our clients are companies from the sectors of central utility supplies and waste management, international development and commercial banks, investors, public administrations, and energy-intensive industrial enterprises. We offer our clients a unique combination of engineering consultancy with classical management consultancy. To maintain our sustainable growth process, we are looking to fill a permanent position overseeing Photovoltaic projects in our Nairobi office as

Senior Consultant / Project Manager Renewable Energy Systems (Photovoltaics & Rural Electrification) - all genders

We are seeking an experienced professional to strengthen our international renewable energy team in our Nairobi office with a particular focus on photovoltaic (PV) projects and related energy infrastructure. The successful candidate will contribute to the technical and project management aspects of large-scale solar projects while also supporting assignments in rural electrification, distributed energy systems and energy access programs. This position combines technical expertise, project delivery and business development in an international consulting environment.

Your Tasks

Lead and manage PV projects across all project phases, from feasibility studies and concept development to tendering, construction supervision, commissioning and operation.
Provide technical consulting services to developers, investors, lenders, utilities and public-sector clients.
Act as Project Manager and technical focal point for national and international consulting assignments.
Perform technical assessments, feasibility studies, owner's engineer services and technical due diligence activities.
Review designs, technical specifications, EPC contractor deliverables and commissioning results.
Support the development and implementation of PV hybrid systems incorporating battery energy storage systems (BESS).
Contribute to projects involving rural electrification, mini-grids, off-grid power systems, solar home systems and distributed renewable energy solutions.
Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams and manage interfaces with clients, contractors, financial institutions and public stakeholders.
Support proposal preparation, business development activities and the expansion of Fichtner's renewable energy portfolio.

Your Profile

University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Renewable Energy, Civil Engineering or a comparable discipline.
At least 8 years of professional experience in PV and renewable energy projects.
Demonstrated experience in technical consulting, engineering or project management for utility-scale or commercial PV projects.
Strong understanding of PV system design, yield assessment, grid integration and construction processes.
Experience with battery energy storage systems and hybrid renewable energy solutions is highly desirable.
Experience in rural electrification, mini-grid development, off-grid systems, distributed energy solutions or energy access programs is considered a strong advantage.
Familiarity with international donor-funded projects (e.g. World Bank, GIZ, KfW, ADB, AfDB, EU) would be beneficial.
Experience working in African emerging markets is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an international, multidisciplinary team.
Valid work permit for Kenia / East Africa and willingness to travel

Corporate Benefits

Permanent contract, competitive salary, health insurance
A modern digital infrastructure, mobile working, flexible working hours
A growing team in a start-up environment backed up by a large global operating company
The opportunity to take responsibility from the start
Exciting projects in the energy industry
Culture of staff appreciation, equal opportunity and attractive career prospects in an international job environment with staff originating from 66 nations

jobs.title: Talent Pool - Insurance Project Manager
jobs.description:
Chez Seyna, notre mission est simple: permettre aux professionnels de l'assurance de protéger ceux qui voient grand.

Rejoins notre mission ! 🚀

Seyna
est un assureur qui apporte une efficacité incomparable aux courtiers. Grâce à sa technologie et à la réactivité de ses équipes, Seyna accompagne les courtiers à chaque étape de leur développement : création du produit d'assurance sur-mesure, outils de vente et de gestion, analyse et amélioration du produit d'assurance, conformité.

Depuis son lancement en 2019, date à laquelle Seyna a obtenu son agrément ACPR d'assureur, Seyna a convaincu plus de 100 courtiers, dont SPVIE, Verspieren, WTW, Garantme, APRIL, Marsh ou encore Dalma. Ils utilisent Seyna pour protéger près de deux millions d'assurés dans 6 pays européens. Grâce à un investissement de 57 millions d'euros de la part de GFC, WhiteStar Capital, Elaia et 115K (La Banque Postale) Seyna a des ambitions mondiales pour améliorer le secteur de l'assurance en modernisant la conception et la gestion des programmes d'assurance.

Aujourd'hui, nous n'avons pas de poste ouvert pour le rôle d'Insurance Project Manager, mais nous savons que les choses peuvent évoluer rapidement. En rejoignant notre Talent Pool, vous serez directement dans la boucle si une nouvelle opportunité se présente.

Pourquoi rejoindre notre Talent Pool ?

Vous serez les premiers informés lorsqu'un poste s'ouvre.
Vous découvrirez ce qui se passe chez Seyna et verrez si ça peut matcher avec vos ambitions.
Et surtout, vous restez en lien avec une entreprise qui partage votre vision.

Si vous croyez en notre mission et que le rôle vous parle, n'attendez plus : postulez ! Si une opportunité se présente, vous serez parmi les premiers à être contactés. 🙌

Ta future équipe :

L'Insurance Project Manager (aussi appelé Insurance Sales Specialist) est une pièce maîtresse du département Sales. Il pilote, aux côtés du Client Executive, la progression de chaque deal d'assurance jusqu'au lancement du produit. Il combine expertise assurance, dimension commerciale et rôle de chef de projet — et c'est cette combinaison qui fait toute sa valeur chez Seyna. Il coordonne les équipes internes (actuariat, juridique, produit, CSM, opérations) et les partenaires courtiers pour garantir des lancements sans accroc et dans les délais.

Ce que tu feras :

Qualifier le besoin du courtier aux côtés du Client Executive et vérifier son alignement avec les capacités assurantielles de Seyna
Coordonner l'équipe projet : actuariat, juridique, produit, CSM, opérations
Piloter les étapes du deal, définir les jalons, clarifier les rôles et garantir le respect des deadlines
Piloter la construction de l'offre : tarif, structure produit, garanties, exclusions
Préparer les supports nécessaires (propositions commerciales, présentations, documents techniques)
Définir la stratégie de closing du deal et prendre le lead dans les échanges avec les courtiers
Assurer la transition fluide vers les équipes CSM et Opérations une fois le produit lancé
Identifier les freins récurrents et proposer des améliorations de process
Effectuer une veille produit & marché pour anticiper les besoins et challenger les courtiers

Tu es au bon endroit si :

Tu as d'excellentes compétences en gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur d'exécution, respect des jalons
Tu as une bonne connaissance du marché de l'assurance et de ses produits (Santé et/ou P&C)
Tu comprends rapidement les enjeux et contraintes des courtiers, et tu sais reformuler et challenger leurs besoins
Tu maîtrises le business model de Seyna et tu sais structurer des offres complètes (tarifs, garanties, exclusions)
Tu communiques avec clarté et pédagogie, y compris sur des sujets techniques, et tu sais convaincre avec énergie et professionnalisme
Tu es autonome, tu prends l'initiative sur tes deals et tu assumes la responsabilité de leur avancement
Tu aimes travailler en équipe et tu collabores naturellement avec des profils variés (CE, actuaires, juristes, CSMs…)

Ce que Seyna te propose :

💵 Rémunération : Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que tu puisses partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons.
🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de tes 28 jours de congés payés.
🍜 Ticket restaurant : Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60 % par Seyna (10 €/jour).
🚇 Transport : 50 % de ton moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna.
🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95 % par Seyna.
🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble.
🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) !

Compensation Range: €50K - €110K

.

🔹 Levantar y documentar procesos, necesidades y requerimientos funcionales.
🔹 Facilitar reuniones y talleres con usuarios de negocio.
🔹 Convertir necesidades en historias de usuario, maquetas usando IA, flujos, reglas de negocio y criterios de aceptación.

.
🔹 Coordinar y acompañar pruebas funcionales y UAT
.
🔹 Mantener seguimiento de compromisos, pendientes, riesgos, decisiones y dependencias.
🔹 Elaborar minutas, informes de avance y evidencias de los proyectos.
🔹 Coordinar actividades entre cliente, desarrollo, arquitectura, QA y otros especialistas.
🔹 Apoyar al Project Manager en cronograma, seguimiento y control de entregables.
🔹 Identificar oportunamente desviaciones o cambios de alcance.

Además, queremos que crezcas con nosotros Conforme avances en el rol, participarás también en la organización y seguimiento de iniciativas internas de IntiSoluciones:
✔ Proyectos internos.
✔ Desarrollo y evolución de nuestros productos y soluciones.
✔ Iniciativas comerciales y de marketing.
✔ Eventos, contenidos y actividades de posicionamiento.
✔ Seguimiento del portafolio de proyectos e iniciativas.
✔ Mejora de nuestros procesos internos de gestión.

No buscamos que seas especialista en todas estas disciplinas. Buscamos a alguien que tenga la capacidad de organizar, coordinar, dar seguimiento y hacer que las cosas sucedan
.

¿Qué perfil buscamos? 🎯 Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia
en roles relacionados con Business Analysis, proyectos de software, transformación digital, consultoría o implementación de soluciones.
Valoraremos experiencia en:
Levantamiento y documentación de requerimientos.
Modelamiento y entendimiento de procesos.
Historias de usuario y criterios de aceptación.
UAT y pruebas funcionales.
Metodologías ágiles.
Azure DevOps, Jira o herramientas similares.
Proyectos de desarrollo e integración de software.
Conceptos de APIs, integraciones, bases de datos y sistemas empresariales.
Experiencia o conocimiento de SAP será valorado, pero no es indispensable.
Inglés a nivel profesional

Más allá de la experiencia, buscamos especialmente: 💡 Capacidad analítica y criterio.
🗣 Muy buena comunicación oral y escrita.

The CDC foundation explains that “Public health is the science of protecting and improving the health of people and their communities. This work is achieved by promoting health lifestyles, researching disease and injury prevention, detecting, preventing, and responding to infectious disease”.

Come be a part of Mecklenburg County’s Public Health department’s vision to “assure the health and safety of our diverse and changing community today and for future generations.”

Manage and oversee operational functions of County health programs to ensure quality, cost effective, efficient, and customer-friendly services. Leads the development, implementation, and evaluation of the Mecklenburg County Public Health Department’s epidemiological initiatives and publications.

jobs.description:
Job Description

As the Environmental Impacts Project Manager, you will lead the planning, delivery and commissioning of sustainability and environmental initiatives across the Leonardo Helicopters (LH) UK portfolio. Working collaboratively with key stakeholders and delivery partners, you will help ensure initiatives are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest standards, while meeting agreed budgets, timelines and performance targets.

Your impact

This is not a traditional end-to-end project management role. While you will take ownership of projects and initiatives, the role is equally about identifying opportunities, bringing people together, influencing positive change and turning sustainability ambitions into meaningful environmental improvements. You will be a passionate advocate for sustainability, using your knowledge, initiative and influence to make a tangible difference across the organisation.

You will provide day-to-day leadership and coordination across environmental and sustainability initiatives, driving performance against key metrics, managing risks and dependencies, and supporting successful implementation.

A key part of the role will be ensuring that Site Facilities environmental and sustainability activities remain fully compliant with UK legislation, LDO UK and LH UK policies, standards and procedures. You will identify opportunities for continuous improvement, challenge existing ways of working and work with stakeholders to develop practical solutions that reduce environmental impact and support the organisation’s wider sustainability ambitions.

Success in this role will require more than technical and project management capability. You will demonstrate a proactive, collaborative and purpose-driven approach, taking ownership, building strong relationships and role-modelling the behaviours needed to influence change. You will be comfortable working across organisational boundaries, engaging stakeholders at all levels and using your passion for sustainability to inspire action.

For the awareness of internal applicants, this role is a JFF level 6. This position is predominantly site based in Yeovil, with occasional working from home.

What you will do as a Site Facilities Environmental Impacts Project Manager:

Provide professional/technical advice in support of the successful delivery of infrastructure projects contributing to the 5-year business planning cycle and delivery of long-term strategies.
Ensure that suitable and sufficient HSE arrangements are deployed and practiced on all projects in accordance with current UK Legislation, LDO UK Policies and Procedures and the LHUK HSEMSM.
Collaborate with specialists such as Energy Managers, Sustainability Managers and local Government Officials for Permits and Licences.
Ensure all legal requirements, building regulations, safety codes, safety inspections, and local and national regulations are met.
Manage HSE issues, ensuring Contractors have a safe working environment within which to operate.
Ensure compliance with the LHUK Facilities project governance processes.
Effectively manage the Site Facilities related elements of audits by Regulatory and Assurance Bodies and Internal Auditors, including ISO14001, ISO45001 and ISO50001.
Manage the delivery of the ISO 50001 Energy Management System for LHUK.
Manage external audits.
Conduct annual review with Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) Energy Partner.
Review and chair the monthly Utilities Working Group (UWG).
Ensure the continuity of Utilities supplies to the LHUK property portfolio.
Responsible for the publication of monthly utilities management reports.
Act as lead for Yeovil Site Utilities management, including gas, water and electricity.
Manage the reduction of Utilities consumption as part of the LHUK commitment to the LDO UK Carbon Net Zero targets.
Ensure that LHUK is compliant with UK legislation for Utilities, including but not limited to CCA, CRC, CCL and Gas Safety.
Help drive innovative ways of working and tools for the wider Energy Decarbonisation Team.
Act as the lead for Social Value (SV) outputs from contract award.
Responsible for the management of EV provision.
Management of solar initiates, both internal and external to the Yeovil site.

Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity

You may be called upon to support the LHUK Emergency Preparedness processes and procedures supporting the Command Emergency Control Centre (ECC), responsible for the management and delivery of the Site Facilities responsibilities, focussed on the management of incident consequences relating to People, Environment, Assets and Reputation (PEAR).

What You’ll Bring

Qualified professional and/or in-depth experience in a relevant environmental, sustainability or facilities discipline.
Working knowledge of sustainability and environmental best practice, legislation, risk management, policies, procedures and market trends.
Willingness to attain Practitioner Membership Standard of the Institute of Sustainability & Environmental Professionals by the end of Year 2 in role, and attain Full membership by the end of year 5
Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, managers, customers, suppliers and regulatory authorities.
Clear understanding of business and functional strategy and how the role contributes to business objectives.
Understanding of real estate, infrastructure and Facilities Management processes, including CDM.
Experience and knowledge of LHUK manufacturing processes.
Financial competence, including budgetary control.
Self-motivated, purpose-driven and proactive, with the ability to deliver positive environmental and business change.

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Business Continuity Program Manager F/M to join the AXA Partners' Security Team.

The ambition of the security organization is to evolve to a business partner role, delivering value to the business while reducing and managing their risk. This by following a risk-based strategy and security improvement program with common objectives and controls.

The Business Continuity Management Program Manager is a part of Central team and is a key discipline within Operational Resilience department to ensure that Business Continuity within the AXA Partners countries is defined, implemented, and delivered in accordance with the Group Security Strategy and supports achieving local maturity objectives in cost-effective manner.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your mission is to ensure the organization’s resilience by overseeing the development, implementation, and testing comprehensive Business Continuity Plans that integrate security, crisis management, IT, and other professional families like HR, and communications functions. It involves identifying and assessing risks, promoting BCM awareness and training, and continuously improving plans and processes through testing and benchmarking. You work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to embed BCM standards, oversee critical business activities, influence organizational change, and support rapid response and recovery in disruptions—ultimately safeguarding critical operations and fostering a proactive, resilient organizational culture.

Your Individual Responsibilities Will Be To

Ensure compliance and execution of tasks according to the Operational Resilience Policy, BCM controls, and international best practices.
Lead and facilitate Business Impact Analyses (BIA), manage the full Business Continuity lifecycle, and provide training.
Maintain expertise in local regulations, international standards, BCM tools (RiskConnect, SendWordNow), and the broader Operational Resilience landscape.
Develop and oversee BCM action plans, promote awareness, conduct training, and coordinate testing activities.
Manage BCM programs and projects, deploy standards and policies, influence change, and ensure adherence.
Provide advice and support during major incidents or crises, utilizing strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors, auditors, and partners, to deliver expected outcomes.
Contribute to strategic planning, report risks, support steering committees, and track progress of resilience initiatives.
Support the implementation of BCM processes and controls, foster a security-aware culture, and ensure regulatory compliance.
Drive continuous improvement of processes, enhance quality, and establish auditable governance for Operational Resilience.

What You’ll Bring

Minimum 10 years of proven experience in Business Continuity, Operational Resilience, and Security, with strong understanding of business processes.
Solid knowledge of BCM standards and practices (ISO 22301, 22316, DRII, BCI) and awareness of relevant regulations (DORA is a plus).
Experience in Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Risk Assessment, Business Continuity Planning, and IT service continuity (RTO, RPO, incident management, security risk analysis).
Familiarity with crisis and incident management, audit processes, and information security; experience in financial or insurance industries is an advantage.
Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools (Excel, Power BI), and BCM tools (e.g., RiskConnect, SendWordNow, ClearView).
Excellent problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills; ability to work independently in a dynamic, global environment.
Strong communication skills in English (additional languages like French or Spanish are assets); capable of producing reports, presentations, and documentation.
Ability to prioritize under pressure, manage risks, and lead in high-stakes situations.
Leadership qualities, team player mindset, proactive, self-motivated, with interpersonal skills including assertiveness, empathy, and persuasive communication.
Relevant educational background, ideally a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Information Systems, or related field.

What We Offer

At AXA Partners, we’re appreciative of the people who work for us and our rewards package is reviewed regularly to reflect that. You can expect to receive:

Company Savings Plan and PERECO

If you have a long-term condition or disability and require adjustments during the application or interview process, please send an email to AXA Partners Global HR Response - globalhr@partners.axa

Who We Are

We’re AXA Partners, experts at designing and delivering assistance solutions and specialised insurance, credit, and lifestyle protection – with and for our partners worldwide. What sets us apart? The expertise and passion of our 8,500+ people, and a strong network of over 55,000 professionals all over the world. Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:
06/10/2026

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

Oplysning Om Indsamling Af Dine Personoplysninger

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.

Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.

Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.

Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.

Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.

Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.

Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.

Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.

Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

PROGRAM MANAGER - ERP TRANSFORMATION

Vil du være med til at drive en af de mest betydningsfulde digitale transformationer i BIRN Groups historie?

BIRN Group står foran implementeringen af en ny fælles ERP-platform på tværs af koncernens selskaber og forretningsområder. Samtidig skal centrale platforme og processer omkring blandt andet produktion, produktdata og master data hænge sammen med ERP-løsningen og understøtte virksomhedens behov.

Derfor søger vi nu en erfaren Program Manager, der kan sikre følgeskab, eksekvere og tage det samlede ansvar for transformationen og føre organisationen sikkert fra beslutning og design til implementering, go-live og stabil drift.

Du får en central rolle i tæt samspil med styregruppen, Group IT Manager, forretningens procesejere samt eksterne leverandører og implementeringspartnere.

Rollen refererer til Group CEO, som er formand for programmets styregruppe.

STILLINGEN

Stillingen er en projektansættelse på 2 år med mulighed for fastansættelse ved projektets afslutning.

Som Program Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for at etablere og drive BIRN Groups ERP-program. Du skaber struktur, fremdrift og tydelige beslutningsveje på tværs af arbejdsprocesser, selskaber og fagområder. Du sikrer samtidig, at mennesker, processer, data og teknologi tænkes sammen, så programmet skaber varige forretningsmæssige forbedringer.

Du leder programmets samlede leverance og skaber et konstruktivt, resultatorienteret samarbejde mellem interne nøglepersoner og eksterne partnere. En vigtig del af opgaven er at omsætte kompleksitet til klare prioriteringer og et transparent beslutningsgrundlag for styregruppe og ledelse.

DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER

Etablere og drive programmets governance, organisering, arbejdsformer og beslutningsstruktur.
Udarbejde og vedligeholde den samlede programplan med scope, milepæle, ressourcer, budget og afhængigheder.
Lede ERP-programmet fra design og implementering til go-live, stabilisering og efterfølgende udrulning på tværs af sites og selskaber.
Styre og koordinere leverandører, implementeringspartnere og øvrige eksterne rådgivere, herunder opfølgning på kontrakter og leverancer.
Sikre sammenhæng mellem ERP og centrale platforme som MES, PLM og øvrige relevante IT- og OT-løsninger i tæt samarbejde med Group IT Manager.
Koordinere Business Process Owners, Master Data Management og Change Management ind i programmets planer og leverancer.
Sikre styring af kvalitet, risici, issues, ændringer, kapacitet og tværgående afhængigheder.
Forberede og drive styregruppemøder samt udarbejde beslutningsoplæg og præcis statusrapportering til ledelsen.
Sikre fokus på business case, gevinstrealisering og organisatorisk forankring gennem hele programmet.
Opbygge og udvikle et stærkt program- og projektteam med tydeligt ansvar, høj samarbejdsevne og en leveranceorienteret kultur.

DIN BAGGRUND

Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring med komplekse transformationsprogrammer og har stået med et tilsvarende ansvar i mindst én større ERP-implementering. Det er en fordel, hvis din erfaring er opnået i en international produktions- eller industrikoncern med flere lokationer og komplekse værdikæder.

Dokumenteret erfaring med Programme Management og større ERP-implementeringer, gerne end-to-end fra design til stabil drift.
Erfaring med multi-site eller international rollout og koordinering på tværs af selskaber, geografier og forretningsenheder.
God forståelse for centrale forretningsprocesser inden for eksempelvis økonomi, indkøb, salg, produktion, logistik og supply chain.
Indsigt i platformslandskabet omkring ERP, herunder MES, PLM, integrationer samt samspillet mellem IT og OT.
Erfaring med leverandørstyring, implementeringspartnere, kommercielle aftaler og kontraktopfølgning.
Forståelse for data- og master data governance samt change management i større transformationsprogrammer.
Stærk økonomisk forståelse og erfaring med budgetstyring, business cases og gevinstrealisering.

DIG SOM PERSON

Du skaber retning og fremdrift og er tydelig, beslutsom og tillidsvækkende i din ledelsesstil.
Du kan bevæge dig sikkert mellem strategiske drøftelser, styring af komplekse leverancer og praktisk problemløsning.
Du arbejder struktureret, følger konsekvent op og formår at udfordre både organisationen og eksterne partnere konstruktivt.
Du kommunikerer klart og præcist og kan oversætte mellem teknik, proces og forretning, både i bestyrelseslokalet og tæt på driften.
Du samarbejder naturligt på tværs, deler viden og skaber ejerskab hos ledere, specialister og brugere.
Vi lægger vægt på den rette profil og er derfor åbne over for kandidater, der ønsker at indgå i rollen via eget CVR-nummer.

BIRN TILBYDER

Et klart mandat og tæt samarbejde med styregruppe, topledelse og nøglepersoner på tværs af BIRN Group.
En central og synlig rolle i et strategisk transformationsprogram med stor betydning for og indflydelse på BIRN Groups digitale fremtid.
Mulighed for at sætte retning for koncernens fremtidige processer, datafundament og digitale platforme.
Et stærkt fagligt miljø med engagerede kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af funktioner og selskaber.
Konkurrencedygtige løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, der matcher din erfaring og rollens ansvar.

OM BIRN

BIRN Group er en af Nordeuropas største støberikoncerner med koncernhovedkvarter i Holstebro og datterselskaber i Danmark, Sverige, Tyskland og Italien.

BIRN Group er udelukkende ordreproducerende og støber, overfladebehandler, bearbejder og monterer højkvalitets støbejernsprodukter til bl.a. lastbilindustrien.

Koncernen har en lang og traditionsrig virksomhedshistorie og beskæftiger omkring 700 medarbejdere, heraf ca. 500 i Holstebro. Hovedparten af produktionen afsættes internationalt.

BIRN Groups DNA udspringer fra vores passionerede medarbejdere, der samarbejder på tværs af koncernen som et fælles team, og som virksomhed og medarbejdere fremstår vi ansvarlige og ordentlige i ord og handling.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i disse værdier, og kan du hertil bidrage til fællesskabet med høj faglighed, godt humør og forandringsparathed, så er du sikkert vores ny kollega.

INTERESSERET

jobs.title: 35F Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

On the battlefield, success depends on accurate and timely intel. As an Army National Guard Intelligence Analyst, you will play a key role in the interpretation and exploitation of information gathered from or about the threat. Intelligence Analysts provide Guard personnel with information about enemy forces and potential battle areas, and use information derived from all intelligence disciplines to determine changes in enemy capabilities, vulnerabilities, and probable courses of action. You’ll gain Military Intelligence training, education, and a security clearance that could open doors to rewarding career opportunities with other intelligence agencies.

Specific duties of the Intelligence Analyst may include: preparing all-source intelligence products; providing Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Synchronization support; processing incoming reports and messages; determining the significance and reliability of incoming information; establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-referencing intelligence records and files; integrating incoming information with current intelligence holdings; and preparing and maintaining enemy situational graphics.

Job Duties

Preparing all-source intelligence products to support the combat commander
Assessing the significance and reliability of incoming intelligence collection
Establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-reference intelligence records and files

Some Of The Skills You’ll Learn

Critical thinking
The ability to use sophisticated mapping tools, intelligence networks, and systems to identify the evolving threat on the battlefield
Gather information utilizing premier digital and analytical tools to create products for the Commander

Helpful Skills

Analytical thinking; gathering information, and understanding of relevancy
Interest in reading maps and charts

More than any other branch of service, the Army National Guard offers a wide range of intelligence-related positions. Through your training, you will develop skills and experience to create opportunities for a civilian career with federal agencies like the National Security Agency.

Earn While You Learn

Instead of paying to learn these skills, get paid to learn. In the Army National Guard, you will learn these valuable job skills while earning a regular paycheck and qualifying for tuition assistance and certifications. Job training for an Intelligence Analyst consists of 10 weeks of Basic Training, where you'll learn basic Soldiering skills, and 13 weeks of Advanced Individual Training (AIT) and on-the-job instruction, including practice in intelligence gathering. You’ll learn in the classroom and gain experience in the field. Completion of your initial entry training in the Army National Guard could also lead to additional college credit.

Benefits/Requirements

Benefits

Paid training
Earn a security clearance
A monthly paycheck
Montgomery GI Bill
Federal and State tuition assistance
Retirement benefits for part-time service
Low-cost life insurance (up to $400,000 in coverage)
401(k)-type savings plan
Student Loan Repayment Program (up to $50,000, for existing loans)
Health care benefits available
VA home loans
Bonuses, if applicable

Most non-prior service candidates will initially earn between $200 and $250 per drill weekend, subject to change.

Requirements

Military enlistment in the Army National Guard
Must be at least a junior in high school, or have a high school diploma or GED certificate
Must be between the ages of 17 and 35
Must be able to pass a physical exam and meet legal and moral standards
Must meet citizenship requirements (see NATIONALGUARD.com for details)

Requires military enlistment. Programs and benefits are subject to change. Ask your Army National Guard recruiter for the most up-to-date information. Actual MOS assignment may depend on MOS availability.

The European Data Governance Analyst supports operationalisation of the European Data Governance Framework through data quality assurance, process documentation, governance reporting and remediation delivery. Excellent Communication skills, can clearly and precisely translate technical detail to easy-to-understand summaries in meetings, presentations and document
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

jobs.description:
En Prex tenemos como propósito de derribar fronteras financieras y simplificar la vida cotidiana de las personas. Queremos ser la plataforma líder en LATAM donde cada persona pueda resolver todas sus necesidades financieras desde un solo lugar. 

Para lograrlo, innovamos todos los días y construimos experiencias únicas con impacto real:  

💳 Más de 6 millones de usuarios ya confían en nosotros. 

🌎 Nuestra tarjeta se usa en +159 países, sin fronteras. 

📍 Presencia local en 4 países de LATAM.

Vivimos nuestros valores en cada acción y con #ActitudPrexer. ¡Queremos que seas parte!

🎯 Tu misión

Serás responsable de identificar, evaluar, mitigar y monitorear los riesgos tecnológicos, operacionales y de seguridad de la información, contribuyendo a una gestión integral del riesgo que proteja los activos digitales y la operación del negocio, y asegurando que las decisiones se tomen con una visión de riesgo sólida, anticipativa y alineada al crecimiento sostenible de la organización.

💡 Tus desafíos

Ser protagonista en la identificación y evaluación de los riesgos tecnológicos y operacionales del negocio, incluyendo los riesgos asociados al uso de IA, la gestión de datos personales y a las prácticas de desarrollo y operación de productos digitales.
Evaluar la efectividad de los controles que mitigan los riesgos identificados, proponiendo mejoras y acompañando su implementación.
Diseñar, acordar y dar seguimiento a planes de acción y remediación frente a desvíos del apetito de riesgo, asegurando una gestión integral y transversal de los riesgos identificados.
Impulsar el diseño, evolución y monitoreo de indicadores de riesgo (KRIs) y tableros de control, gestionando alertas por superación de umbrales, realizando análisis de causa raíz y coordinando acciones preventivas.
Aportar una mirada de riesgo en el lanzamiento de nuevos productos y servicios, así como en iniciativas tecnológicas clave, proponiendo acciones para mitigar vulnerabilidades y anticipar impactos operativos, tecnológicos y reputacionales.
Colaborar en la actualización del Business Impact Analysis (BIA) y otros elementos del Plan de Continuidad del Negocio, asegurando su alineación con los riesgos tecnológicos y operacionales.
Ser protagonista en la gestión del riesgo de terceras partes, incluyendo evaluaciones iniciales y periódicas, revisiones contractuales, análisis de incidentes y estimación de impacto.
Colaborar en la gestión, actualización y análisis de la base de eventos de pérdida.
Trabajar proactivamente en el cumplimiento normativo en materia de gestión de riesgos, en base a los requisitos regulatorios en todos los mercados donde Prex opera.
Elaborar reportes claros, accionables y orientados al negocio, brindando insights relevantes para la toma de decisiones estratégicas y para preservar la integridad operativa y reputacional de la organización.
Participar activamente en la creación de capacitaciones, contenidos y actividades de concientización, promoviendo una sólida cultura de riesgo en la organización y acompañando el Plan Anual de Concientización.

🔍 Lo que buscamos de vos

+4 años de experiencia en gestión de riesgos tecnológicos y operacionales, idealmente dentro de la industria de servicios financieros o en entornos con alto nivel de regulación.
Profesionales de las carreras de Ingeniería en Tecnología, Analistas en Sistemas o afines.
Conocimiento sólido del marco regulatorio y de buenas prácticas de Risk Management (COSO-ERM, ISO 31000, entre otros), así como experiencia en diseño y mejora de procesos.
Se valorará conocimiento en estándares internacionales (ISO, COBIT, PCI DSS, NIST).
Valoramos experiencia en herramientas de análisis de datos, visualización y automatización que ayuden a potenciar la gestión de riesgos.
Mentalidad estratégica y visión de largo plazo para diseñar indicadores, controles y estructuras escalables en un contexto dinámico y desafiante.
Personas con excelentes habilidades de comunicación, trabajo en equipo, pensamiento crítico, proactividad y fuerte orientación analítica.

🎁 Lo que Prex tiene para vos

Una cultura que impulsa el desarrollo genuino de las personas, donde las ideas se escuchan y se valoran.
Modalidad híbrida de trabajo en las oficinas de Montevideo & Home Office en el exterior.
Día de cumpleaños flexible.
Tu cuenta Prex Internacional con bonificaciones exclusivas.
Acceso a plataformas de capacitación y aprendizaje.
Descuentos en universidades y centros de formación.
Clases de idiomas.
Set up para que trabajes más cómodo.

Ser Prexer, cuenta! 😉

Are you fascinated by data and eager to turn numbers into real business insights? We are looking for a curious and driven Junior Data Analyst to join our growing Data Team in Ostrava. We leverage a modern cloud data platform built on Azure and Databricks,
where we process and analyze data at scale. You'll develop reports and dashboards in Power BI,

What You’ll Be Doing

Analyze data and develop reports and dashboards that help the business make smarter decisions
Support the implementation and development of production analytical systems
Be an active part of data projects – explore, crunch, and model data to uncover insights
Ensure data assets are well-documented, accessible, and of high quality
Collaborate with the Data Team to answer real business questions with the right analytical solutions
Contribute to improving data maturity across all business lines

What You’ll Bring

Minimum secondary education (university background in IT, statistics, or economics is a plus)
English proficiency at B2 level – you'll use it regularly
Advanced knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel

Responsibility, reliability, and a team-first attitude
Experience with data management or governance? Even better!

At AXA Partners, we’re appreciative of the people who work for us and our rewards package is reviewed regularly to reflect that. You can expect to receive:

25 days of vacation
Meal vouchers worth 150 CZK from day one
Home office 2 days per week (after training), including full equipment (laptop, monitor, docking station, etc.)
Smart working allowance
MultiSport or Flexi Pass (500 CZK/month contribution)
Telemedicine – 24/7 online medical support for you and up to five family members
Pension contribution (1,000 CZK/month)
Fully covered life insurance
Free European travel insurance, including coverage for extreme sports and roadside assistance
Development programs and courses, including access to LinkedIn Learning
A friendly team of colleagues
Office refreshments

To apply, click on the ‘apply for this job’ button, you’ll then need to log in or create a profile to submit your CV. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and don’t discriminate against employees or potential employees based on protected characteristics. If you have a long-term condition or disability and require adjustments during the application or interview process, please send an email to AXA Partners Global HR Response - globalhr@partners.axa

Who We Are

We’re AXA Partners, experts at designing and delivering assistance solutions and specialised insurance, credit, and lifestyle protection – with and for our partners worldwide. What sets us apart? The expertise and passion of our 8,500+ people, and a strong network of over 55,000 professionals all over the world. Powered by them and our sector-leading technology, we continuously evolve, adapt and thrive – offering solutions and services that make sure we’re always at people’s side, no matter what. Helping others is our passion. Combining the best digital technology with our warm, human touch, we’re always looking at new ways to offer seamless and reassuring experiences when it really matters.

jobs.title: Global Financial Crimes Investigations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title:
Global Financial Crimes Manager

Corporate Title:
Vice President

Location:
Dublin

Company Overview:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.

Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

Location Overview:

Overlooking the spectacular Iveagh Gardens with access to all amenities in the beating heart of central Dublin is our Park Place office. Travel options include the LUAS, Dublin Bus networks as well as the Dublin Bikes station, positioned just outside our front doors. As part of our commitment to supporting staff travel to and from work in the most sustainable way possible, we also provide tax saver tickets as part of our award-winning benefits package which means getting to work has never been easier.

Job Description:

The GFC Investigations Manager ensures significant issues and financial crimes trends related to fraud, money laundering, or terrorist financing are effectively communicated and acted upon.
The GFC Investigations Manager may also work closely with law enforcement, regulatory agencies and industry counterparts to proactively share intelligence, best practices, etc. Additional responsibilities for this role include capacity planning, providing leadership direction, attracting, assessing, developing, motivating and retaining a successful team.
The GFC Investigations Manager ensures consistent quality of activities, processes and outputs by reinforcing effective review practices across the team. Activities this role performs include, but are not limited to:
Oversees investigative efforts, reviewing and approving cases and ensuring the delivery of timely and accurate regulatory reporting
Provides oversight of a team of Investigators or activities performing end-to-end investigations of financial crimes activities across multiple jurisdictions and legal entities.
Ensures that the completion of Suspicious Activity Reports is conducted in a timely and accurate manner for submission to regulators and/or law enforcement, while providing review and oversight
Reviews facts of the investigation, and escalates risk to senior stakeholders and partners with Front Line Units to resolve
Leads quality control functions, training, communications, guidance, monitoring scenario development/enhancement input and testing, or law enforcement liaison responsibilities in an investigative support role
Evaluates internal controls to ensure they are working effectively by identifying weaknesses or gaps
Leads or contributes to the execution of the financial crimes program, including but not limited to regulatory change, financial crimes policies and procedures management, risk assessments, issue management as well as any global or regional driven initiatives and projects
Oversees or assists in the development of remediation plans to strengthen controls and providing oversight to ensure they are addressed appropriately.

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company D&I goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

Skills:

Coaching
External Resource Management
Investigation Management, including ability to manage complex cases and work under pressure.
Regulatory Compliance
Issue Management
Confident working within global policies, procedures and risk management guidelines
Policies, Procedures, and Guidelines Management
Risk Management
Strategy Planning and Development
Written Communications
Excellent analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and report-writing abilities, including ability to communicate with stakeholders globally

Required Qualifications:

Demonstrated business and functional experience
Degree required: Bachelor’s or equivalent experience
Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (preferred)
Proven experience within a similar role from the financial services industry and / or government entity

Benefits of working at Bank of America (Ireland):

Private healthcare for you and your family plus an annual health screen to help you manage your physical wellness with the option to purchase a screen for your partner
Competitive pension plan, life assurance and group income protection cover if you become unable to work as a result of a disability or health reasons
20 days of back-up childcare and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum
The ability to change your core benefits as well as the option of selecting a variety of flexible benefits to suit your personal circumstances including access to a wellbeing account, travel insurance, critical illness etc.
Access to an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support and help for everyday matters
Access to free counselling through the Employee Assistance Program and virtual GP services through our private health care plan
Ability to donate to charities of your choice and the bank will match your contribution
Opportunity to access our Arts & Culture corporate membership program and receive discounted entry to some of Ireland’s most iconic cultural institutions and exhibitions.
Opportunity to give back to your community, develop new skills and work with new groups of people by volunteering in your local community.

Bank of America:

Good conduct and sound judgment is crucial to our long-term success. It’s important that all employees in the organisation understand the expected standards of conduct and how we manage conduct risk. Individual accountability and an ownership mind-set are the cornerstones of our Code of Conduct and are at the heart of managing risk well.

We are an equal opportunities employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, membership of the Traveller community, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, civil status, socio-economic background, family status or physical or mental disability. The Bank selects candidates for interview based on their skills, qualifications and experience.

We strive to ensure that our recruitment processes are accessible for all candidates and encourage any candidates to tell us about any adjustment requirements.

Job Title: Compliance & Operations Analyst

Experience:
3-5 years

Location:
Pune

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled ERP compliance Analyst to manage & support the IT compliance framework. We are looking for someone who combines strong compliance knowledge with a practical and execution-oriented mindset.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working hands-on, collaborating across functions, identifying gaps, improving processes, and ensuring compliance requirements are consistently implemented. Support day-to-day compliance activities, including but not limited to users onboarding, compliance monitoring and maintenance of regulatory records.

Assist with regulatory filings, audits, compliance reviews, internal controls, training and other compliance initiatives.

Support daily operations, including quality checks, reconciliations, monitoring and resolution of operational discrepancies.

Maintain accurate compliance and operational documentation and coordinate with internal teams, counterparties and external auditors.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for executing day-to-day compliance operations, ensuring that all related IT activities and users onboarding undergo comprehensive risk-based screening in strict alignment with SOX compliance and internal policies.
Maintain SOX Governance, Access Controls, Segregation of Duties, Change management tracking, and data integrity checks as per SOX controls.
Ensure compliance of IT General Controls, Evidence and Documentation Controls to pass through Audit review without any risk.
Support tickets routing, administration and control ticketing life cycle.
Strong Project Management skill to enforce required controls in timely manner.
Play a key role in encouraging communication among cross-functional teams, using collaboration tools to keep everyone in the loop and foster a collaborative environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, Economics, Law or a related discipline.
Experience working with Sarbanes-Oxley SOX Compliance, preferable Certified SOX Professional.
Strong understanding of financial systems.
Proficiency in Project management, JIRA and ServiceNow
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Join us and be part of a dedicated team that drives innovation and efficiency through effective IT solutions.

jobs.title: Interoperability Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Zus is a shared health data platform designed to accelerate healthcare data interoperability by providing easy-to-use patient data via API, embedded components, and direct EHR integrations. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus partners with HIEs and other data networks to aggregate patient clinical history and then translates that history into user-friendly information at the point of care. Zus's mission is to catalyze healthcare's greatest inventors by maximizing the value of patient insights - so that they can build up, not around.

What We're Looking For

Every customer on the Zus network should have access to the most comprehensive clinical data possible and should understand exactly what they have. As Interoperability Operations Analyst, you'll build the metrics, intelligence, and tooling that make that possible. You'll dig into where coverage is strong and where it's thin, surface the reasons why, and partner with support and solutions teams to close the gaps. When the right fix is a query, you'll write it. When it's an automated workflow, you'll build it.

This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a SQL editor and a Python script, gets genuinely curious about unexplained patterns in data, and is excited about using AI tools to work faster and smarter. You'll sit at the intersection of data, operations, and product. Your insights will shape how the network grows and how we serve our customers

As part of our team, you will be focused on...

Coverage Intelligence
Build and maintain the metrics and dashboards that track clinical data coverage across the Zus network — by geography, network, data type, and customer
Identify coverage gaps and anomalies, investigate root causes, and communicate findings clearly to customers and internal stakeholders
Deliver the regular coverage intelligence that helps every customer understand the depth and breadth of their data — and what's driving any gaps

Operations Partnership

Work closely with support and solutions teams to translate coverage findings into operational actions — escalations, network outreach, configuration changes
Develop and maintain playbooks for recurring coverage issues, turning one-off investigations into repeatable processes
Contribute to onboarding quality by flagging patterns in new participant data that suggest connectivity or configuration problems

Tooling & Automation

Build internal tools, scripts, and automated workflows that reduce manual analysis and surface insights faster
Experiment with AI tools (including Claude) and BI platforms to accelerate how the team operates
Partner with engineering and product to ensure the systems we rely on generate the signals we need

Product Feedback Loop

Translate operational data into product requirements — if a coverage gap is systematic, you'll articulate why it's a product problem and what solving it would require
Partner with UX and engineering to shape internal and customer-facing experiences that make coverage intelligence intuitive and actionable

You're a good fit because you have...

SQL fluency: You write queries naturally and reach for them first when you have a question about data. Experience with BI tools (Looker, Metabase, Tableau, etc.) is a plus
Automation instinct: You don't accept manual work as permanent. You're comfortable in Python and curious about AI-assisted workflows — you'd rather build a system than repeat a task
Analytical curiosity: You notice when numbers don't add up and you follow the thread. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguous data and forming hypotheses
Clear communicator: You can translate a coverage analysis into a crisp, jargon-free narrative for a customer or an executive
Healthcare interest: Prior exposure to clinical data formats (FHIR, HL7, C-CDA) or the provider/EMR ecosystem is a plus, but a genuine interest in how healthcare data flows is what matters most

Why this role matters...

Data coverage is one of the most tangible levers for customer value at Zus and right now, the infrastructure for understanding and improving it is still being built. You'll have real ownership over that build: the metrics, the tooling, and the feedback loops that help the network get better over time. The work compounds.

We will offer you…

Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team a combination of cash and equity
Robust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, unlimited PTO
Opportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)

Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.

We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.
