jobs.description:
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets and manage risks.

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as Lead Business Analyst – Actuarial Commercial Lines
to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make Your Mark

General Insurance is a leading provider of insurance products and services – focused on helping to manage risk for commercial and personal customers. We offer a broad range of products through a diversified, multi-channel distribution network, including one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. The Data Office supports the overall General Insurance product by managing Data, Data Governance, and the presentation of the data (Business Intelligence Delivery).

How You Will Create An Impact

AIG is looking for a driven individual to assume a critical role within the Data Office. This role will work directly with the Actuarial and Data teams to ensure a clear understanding of data and analytics needs and priorities. In addition, the individual will hold Global Data Warehouse Product Ownership responsibilities, ensuring execution aligns with the highest business priorities and Data Office strategy, and that sunset opportunities are realized.

About The Role

The Business Analyst – Actuarial, Commercial Lines
role sits within the Global Data Office at the intersection of business strategy, data, and analytics, and works closely with Commercial Lines Actuarial Groups. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of actuarial concepts (reserving, pricing, and risk assessment), proven data and analytics capabilities, excellent communication skills, and experience as an Agile Product Owner. In this role, you will translate complex actuarial business requirements into actionable data engineering specifications by collaborating directly with data development teams. As a trusted business partner and product owner within the Global Data Warehouse, this role will help shape how AIG uses data to make better decisions, simplify its analytics landscape, and focus investments where they matter most .

Responsibilities

Business Requirements:
Lead deep, structured requirement sessions with senior actuaries to understand workflows, data nuances, and reporting needs, creating detailed functional specifications.

Stakeholder Management: Facilitate alignment across actuaries and Data Office teams on project priorities, project timelines, and management of the deliverables.
Product Owner for Data Platform & Tool Development: Develop roadmaps for actuarial data and tool development requirements and partner with data engineers to build and deploy them in timely manner.
Agile Development Leadership & Product Backlog Management
Lead Agile Ceremonies: Act as the Business Analyst Lead within an agile team, facilitating user story refinement, sprint planning, and daily scrums.
Backlog Grooming: Translate actuarial requirements (reserving, pricing, modeling) into actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria for developers.

Data Governance & Quality: Ensure compliance with data standards and maintain rigorous documentation for data lineage, testing, and production changes.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Experience: 7+ years of experience in business analysis, actuarial tool design within the insurance/financial industry.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or related field.
Actuarial Knowledge: Strong understanding of Commercial Insurance actuarial concepts (e.g., reserving methods, pricing tools)
Data Proficiency: Experience with data environments, ETL and visualization tools
Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading Agile teams and managing product backlogs.
Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications: Actuarial Credentials, actuarial exams, or deep understanding of actuarial reserving/pricing concepts.

Ready to make a bigger impact? We look forward to reviewing your application.

Veterans are encouraged to apply.

For positions based in New Jersey, the base salary range is $110,000 - $140,000. For positions based in New York, the base salary range is $115,000- $144,000. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. If your compensation expectations are above the posted range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits Overview.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. jobs.description:
À propos de nous

La Caisse nationale de solidarité pour l’autonomie (CNSA), établissement public, gère depuis 2021 la nouvelle branche de la Sécurité sociale visant à soutenir l’autonomie des personnes âgées et des personnes en situation de handicap.

En charge du pilotage de la gestion du risque, elle veille à l’équilibre financier de la branche dont le budget s’élève à plus de 43 milliards d’euros. Elle assure également l’animation des acteurs territoriaux, soutient la qualité de service, favorise le développement et la transformation de l’offre et l’accès aux droits afin de garantir la continuité des parcours. Elle joue un rôle clé dans l’information du public et contribue à la recherche dans le champ de l’autonomie. Pour mener à bien ses missions, la Caisse a élaboré un ambitieux schéma directeur des systèmes d’information.

Proximité, innovation et solidarité sont au cœur de ses valeurs.

Basée en plein Paris, à 2 mn de la gare Montparnasse, la Caisse est un établissement à taille humaine. Elle propose une diversité de métiers autour de la conduite de projets, l’animation territoriale, l’expertise médico-sociale, le pilotage financier, la production de données et le déploiement de systèmes d’information…

Pour continuer à améliorer la réponse aux besoins des personnes, à leurs aidants et aux professionnels et relever les défis de la nouvelle branche de Sécurité sociale, la CNSA se transforme et recrute ! Pour plus d’informations, vous pouvez consulter notre site internet (https://www.cnsa.fr).

Mission

La CNSA souhaite renforcer ses capacités d'anticipation et de gestion du risque financier de la branche à moyen terme afin d'éclairer les décisions de la direction générale, des tutelles et des pouvoirs publics.

Pour y parvenir, le-la titulaire vient renforcer nos compétences en projections des besoins concernant le champ de l’autonomie et de développement de l’offre intégrant une dimension socio-démographique, économique et les compétences permettant une meilleure compréhension des parcours des personnes concernées en croisant les données disponibles. Ce poste est rattaché à la DPE, future direction des statistiques.

Vous prendrez en charge une partie des missions suivantes :

Développer les capacités de prévision et de projection de la caisse : produire, améliorer ou décliner à un niveau territorial approprié des analyses prospectives relatives aux besoins d'accompagnement, aux évolutions démographiques, à l'offre médico-sociale et aux trajectoires de dépenses en s’appuyant notamment sur les travaux de la DREES, de l’INSEE, des directions métiers et des partenaires ; penser d’emblée le besoin des acteurs territoriaux dans ces projections et la mise à disposition des résultats en open data
Concevoir et exploiter des modèles d'analyse : développer des modèles de projection et d'estimation des dynamiques de l'autonomie notamment sur le champ du handicap en structurant et animant un groupe de travail dédié ; réaliser des travaux de simulation et d'évaluation ex ante des impacts de réformes dans les champs non-couverts actuellement au sein de la CNSA ; exploiter les données croisées du SNDS et des systèmes d’informations de la CNSA par les techniques de data science pour comprendre les trajectoires des personnes concernées et anticiper les besoins.
Renforcer la gestion du risque et la capacité d'anticipation : identifier et analyser les principaux risques susceptibles d'affecter l'équilibre financier, l'offre de services, les besoins des publics ou la mise en œuvre des politiques publiques ; développer des approches de gestion du risque fondées sur l'analyse des données, les projections et les scénarios prospectifs ; éclairer les déterminants des dépenses et les enjeux de soutenabilité en s’appuyant sur les recherches financées par la caisse (travaux de l’IPP, de Dauphine…), sur la littérature existante ou sur les collaborations existantes ; contribuer au rapport de branche en s’appuyant sur l’ensemble de ces analyses
Diffuser les connaissances : produire des notes de synthèse, documents d'aide à la décision et éléments de prospective à destination de la direction, des cabinets ministériels et des tutelles ; valoriser les travaux réalisés dans des revues et colloques correspondant au niveau des analyses conduites ;
Assurer une veille sur les évolutions démographiques, économiques et institutionnelles susceptibles d'affecter la branche Autonomie et sur les techniques économiques ou statistiques permettant de conduire les missions décrites. Profil

Compétences Générales

Vision stratégique et sens de l'intérêt général
Curiosité intellectuelle et goût pour l'innovation méthodologique
Rigueur scientifique et esprit critique
Capacité à prendre du recul et à formuler des recommandations
Sens du collectif et aptitude à travailler en réseau
Autonomie, initiative et capacité à construire une fonction nouvelle au sein de l'établissement
Diplomatie et aisance relationnelle

Compétences Techniques

Maîtrise des méthodes de prévision statistique et de projection démographique, financière
Expérience de construction et d'exploitation de modèles d'aide à la décision
Connaissance des méthodes de microsimulation et de modélisation des comportements
Analyser les déterminants de la dépense publique et les enjeux de soutenabilité
Produire des analyses prospectives à moyen et long terme
Maîtrise des méthodes d'analyse quantitative et de traitement de données massives.
Bonne connaissance des politiques de l'autonomie, du médico-social et de la protection sociale ;

Diplôme de niveau Bac +5 en statistique, économétrie, économie, data science, mathématiques appliquées, actuariat, santé publique ou politiques publiques ou d’un doctorat, vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans les domaines de la prévision, modélisation et / ou traitement des données de masse en vue de produire des analyses approfondies, idéalement au sein d’un service statistique de la sphère publique ou de Sécurité Sociale.

INFORMATIONS COMPLEMENTAIRES

Contrat : CDI

Prise de fonction : Dès que possible

Lieu d’affectation : 66 Avenue du Maine, 75014 Paris, à proximité immédiate de la Gare Montparnasse et accessible via le métro ligne 4, 6,12 et 13 ainsi que de nombreuses lignes de bus (28, 58, 82, 88, 89, 91, 92, 94, 95 et 96)

new_jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hou je van analytisch werk én van sociale interactie met consultants, klanten en leidinggevenden? Heb je een bewezen track record in projectmanagement binnen ERP-projecten en de maakindustrie? Wil je projecten en services van dichtbij opvolgen en echte impact maken in een complexe, digitale omgeving? Zoek je een plek waar je kan groeien, bijdragen aan innovatie en tegelijk je kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365 en projectmanagement verder kan verdiepen? Dan is deze rol als Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO Project Manager
bij 9altitudes
wellicht jouw volgende stap.

Je dagelijkse avontuur

Als Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO Project Manager
ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor alle fases van implementatieprojecten en streef je naar continue verbetering van processen en resultaten.

Je bewaakt de scope, het budget en de projectplanning en volgt deze rigoureus op van project naar project.
Je staat garant voor hoogwaardige projectoplevering en zorgt voor maximale tevredenheid van de klant.
Je fungeert als Trusted Advisor en vormt de brug tussen de operationele processen van klanten en de mogelijkheden van Microsoft Dynamics 365, waarbij je behoeften vertaalt naar schaalbare digitale oplossingen.
Je stuurt projectteams aan, motiveert en coacht teamleden, en zorgt dat iedereen op één lijn zit met de projectdoelstellingen.
Je organiseert regelmatig projectgesprekken en klantvergaderingen, bijstuurt waar nodig en neemt proactief beslissingen om projecten op koers te houden.
Je rapporteert duidelijk aan het PMO Management over voortgang, budget en risico’s.
Je draagt bij aan een cultuur van verbetering en optimalisatie, zodat elk project succesvoller en efficiënter verloopt dan het vorige.

Vaardigheden

Je bent Master of een ervaren Bachelor met gelijkwaardig kennisniveau, aangevuld met minstens 5 jaar ervaring in projectmanagement bij de implementatie van IT- en bedrijfsoplossingen
Je hebt ervaring met ERP-projecten, bij voorkeur binnen de maakindustrie
Je hebt inzicht in één of meerdere businessprocessen: logistiek, productie, planning, warehouse management, verkoop, aankoop, financiën, project accounting
Je bent PRINCE2 Foundation en ITIL v4 Foundation gecertificeerd en/of bent bereid je hierin bij te scholen.
Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit, neemt ownership over projectenen begrijpt de uitdagingen en noden tijdens transformatie- en implementatietrajecten.
Je bent vlot in Nederlands en Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk)

Je travelpack wordt gevuld met

Aantrekkelijk verloningspakket: competitief salaris, extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques en een elektrische firmawagen met laadpas.
Personaliseer je eindejaarspremie via het 9A Flexplan: extra laptop, bureaustoel of andere opties die voor jou waardevol zijn.
Werk-privébalans & flexibiliteit: we helpen je een gezond evenwicht te vinden tussen werk en privé, met de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken (thuis of op kantoor: Antwerpen, Gent, Kortrijk).
Een uitgebreide onboarding en een persoonlijk opleidingstraject: Stel samen met je teamlead een gepersonaliseerd groeipad op, afhankelijk van jouw ambities en interesses.
Ontdek en groei binnen de “9A-community”, waar kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om certificaten en opleidingen te volgen.
Afwisselende opdrachten: projecten bij diverse klanten met een focus op de maakindustrie.
Werk samen met collega’s over de landsgrenzen heen binnen de 9altitudes-groep en leer van best practices uit verschillende landen.
Versterk de band met je collega’s tijdens verbindende events zoals het nieuwjaars- en zomerevent, de jaarlijkse quiz, business updates/afterworks, de Family Day en de Elevate Together Day.
Bijdragen aan groei: speel een actieve rol in het succes en de uitbreiding van 9altitudes-activiteiten in België en Europa.
Word onderdeel van een innovatieve werkcontext met de nieuwste technologieën, binnen een Microsoft Gold en Scale Fast Partner.

Neem contact op

Bij 9altitudes
krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de internationale voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie. Met meer dan 750 collega’s in 9 landen combineren we diepgaande expertise in o.a. ERP, CE, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IoT & Augmented Reality, CAD en eCommerce. Samen creëren we meer dan oplossingen: we leveren échte waarde en zetten mee de toon voor duurzame resultaten bij onze klanten.

Klaar om met ons mee te groeien en je carrière naar nieuwe hoogtes te tillen? Zet vandaag nog de eerste stap in jouw nieuwe avontuur en solliciteer eenvoudig via onze website.

Wil je zien hoe wij samen grenzen verleggen, innovatieve business solutions creëren en hoogtepunten vieren? Volg ons dan op LinkedIn
en blijf op de hoogte van onze projecten, successen en events.

About Us

At Mecklenburg County, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are with support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on YOUR unique voice and perspective to help Mecklenburg County Public Health become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a healthier world for all.

As a member of the Mecklenburg County Public Health team, you will become a subject matter expert in the public health field. The CDC foundation explains that “Public health is the science of protecting and improving the health of people and their communities. This work is achieved by promoting health lifestyles, researching disease and injury prevention, detecting, preventing, and responding to infectious disease”.

Come be a part of Mecklenburg County’s Public Health department’s vision to “assure the health and safety of our diverse and changing community today and for future generations.”

Position Summary

Manage and oversee operational functions of County health programs to ensure quality, cost effective, efficient, and customer-friendly services. Sr. Health Program Managers oversee a wide variety of public health functions, including case management and care coordination, quality improvement/assurance, public health informatics, environmental health, community engagement, large-scale grants and clinic operations. A senior managerial position is responsible for aligning the strategic goals of the program(s) with the strategic goals of the Public Health Department and the County, implementing strategies to achieve these goals, assuring compliance with state and federal requirements and for providing professional/technical administrative management and direction for program managers and supervisors.

Essential Functions

Leads the development, implementation, and evaluation of the Mecklenburg County Public Health Department’s epidemiological initiatives and publications.
Conducts data analysis and reviews health indicators to assist leadership with measuring the health status of the county.
Performs special studies, develops reports and attends meetings. Manages the collection, analysis, and dissemination of public health data
Directs the daily operations of the Epidemiology program and provides general administrative and technical leadership of functions and activities
Advises the Mecklenburg County Health Director and the executive team on epidemiology, morbidity and mortality trends, and health risks
Provide leadership in developing, aligning and implementing strategic goals of the program with strategic goals of the division, department and County.
Participate in community-level planning to develop partnerships with healthcare providers and areas of collaborative practice to ensure programs’ needs are met
Assist with identifying funding opportunities and developing funding proposals
Participate in the development of policies and procedures for area of responsibility
In the event of a public health emergency, employees may be trained for and assigned duties unrelated to their regular work; work outside normal business hours and workdays and/or in a different work location may be required.

Emergency events include, but are not limited to, communicable disease outbreaks, severe weather situations (e.g. snow or ice storms, tornados, hurricanes), natural disasters (e.g. earthquakes), fire, or power outages, and acts of terrorism.

new_jobs.title: Site Facilities Project Manager – Environmental Impacts
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

As the Environmental Impacts Project Manager, you will lead the planning, delivery and commissioning of sustainability and environmental initiatives across the Leonardo Helicopters (LH) UK portfolio. Working collaboratively with key stakeholders and delivery partners, you will help ensure initiatives are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest standards, while meeting agreed budgets, timelines and performance targets.

Your impact

This is not a traditional end-to-end project management role. While you will take ownership of projects and initiatives, the role is equally about identifying opportunities, bringing people together, influencing positive change and turning sustainability ambitions into meaningful environmental improvements. You will be a passionate advocate for sustainability, using your knowledge, initiative and influence to make a tangible difference across the organisation.

You will provide day-to-day leadership and coordination across environmental and sustainability initiatives, driving performance against key metrics, managing risks and dependencies, and supporting successful implementation.

A key part of the role will be ensuring that Site Facilities environmental and sustainability activities remain fully compliant with UK legislation, LDO UK and LH UK policies, standards and procedures. You will identify opportunities for continuous improvement, challenge existing ways of working and work with stakeholders to develop practical solutions that reduce environmental impact and support the organisation’s wider sustainability ambitions.

Success in this role will require more than technical and project management capability. You will demonstrate a proactive, collaborative and purpose-driven approach, taking ownership, building strong relationships and role-modelling the behaviours needed to influence change. You will be comfortable working across organisational boundaries, engaging stakeholders at all levels and using your passion for sustainability to inspire action.

For the awareness of internal applicants, this role is a JFF level 6. This position is predominantly site based in Yeovil, with occasional working from home.

What you will do as a Site Facilities Environmental Impacts Project Manager:

Provide professional/technical advice in support of the successful delivery of infrastructure projects contributing to the 5-year business planning cycle and delivery of long-term strategies.
Ensure that suitable and sufficient HSE arrangements are deployed and practiced on all projects in accordance with current UK Legislation, LDO UK Policies and Procedures and the LHUK HSEMSM.
Collaborate with specialists such as Energy Managers, Sustainability Managers and local Government Officials for Permits and Licences.
Ensure all legal requirements, building regulations, safety codes, safety inspections, and local and national regulations are met.
Manage HSE issues, ensuring Contractors have a safe working environment within which to operate.
Ensure compliance with the LHUK Facilities project governance processes.
Effectively manage the Site Facilities related elements of audits by Regulatory and Assurance Bodies and Internal Auditors, including ISO14001, ISO45001 and ISO50001.
Manage the delivery of the ISO 50001 Energy Management System for LHUK.
Manage external audits.
Conduct annual review with Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) Energy Partner.
Review and chair the monthly Utilities Working Group (UWG).
Ensure the continuity of Utilities supplies to the LHUK property portfolio.
Responsible for the publication of monthly utilities management reports.
Act as lead for Yeovil Site Utilities management, including gas, water and electricity.
Manage the reduction of Utilities consumption as part of the LHUK commitment to the LDO UK Carbon Net Zero targets.
Ensure that LHUK is compliant with UK legislation for Utilities, including but not limited to CCA, CRC, CCL and Gas Safety.
Help drive innovative ways of working and tools for the wider Energy Decarbonisation Team.
Act as the lead for Social Value (SV) outputs from contract award.
Responsible for the management of EV provision.
Management of solar initiates, both internal and external to the Yeovil site.

Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity

You may be called upon to support the LHUK Emergency Preparedness processes and procedures supporting the Command Emergency Control Centre (ECC), responsible for the management and delivery of the Site Facilities responsibilities, focussed on the management of incident consequences relating to People, Environment, Assets and Reputation (PEAR).

What You’ll Bring

Qualified professional and/or in-depth experience in a relevant environmental, sustainability or facilities discipline.
Working knowledge of sustainability and environmental best practice, legislation, risk management, policies, procedures and market trends.
Willingness to attain Practitioner Membership Standard of the Institute of Sustainability & Environmental Professionals by the end of Year 2 in role, and attain Full membership by the end of year 5
Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, managers, customers, suppliers and regulatory authorities.
Clear understanding of business and functional strategy and how the role contributes to business objectives.
Understanding of real estate, infrastructure and Facilities Management processes, including CDM.
Experience and knowledge of LHUK manufacturing processes.
Financial competence, including budgetary control.
Self-motivated, purpose-driven and proactive, with the ability to deliver positive environmental and business change.

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

Pacten is a business operating system — CRM, bookings, invoicing, delivery and marketing in one place instead of eight. Pacten Studio is the team that runs marketing for our clients on top of it: content calendars, production, and managed ad services. We’re scaling from a handful of clients to a full roster, and we need someone senior to own how that work actually gets delivered.

What you’ll own

Client onboarding, end to end.
Signed contract to a working workspace, a live client hub, and a first content calendar in production — on a repeatable timeline rather than a heroic one.
The content production pipeline , across every client at once.
Managed ad services delivery — brief in, campaigns live, results back to the client, on schedule.
Resourcing across editors, designers, videographers and external creatives, with real capacity planning rather than whoever answers first.
Client onboarding and support desk triage management across various support types and teams.
The client relationship during delivery — status, expectations, and the awkward conversation had early rather than late.
The process itself. You’ll be the first senior PM here, so you are building the delivery function, not inheriting one.

What we’re looking for

5+ years running client delivery in an agency, studio or services business.
You’ve carried multiple concurrent accounts and can talk specifics — how many, what slipped, what you changed so it stopped slipping.
You own a process , not a task list. Comfortable deciding how something should work and then holding people to it.
Writing is most of this job. Briefs, status, scope changes, the difficult email. Clear beats clever.
Fast on new systems — you’ll run the whole thing inside Pacten itself.

Helpful, not required

Marketing or content production background — you know why a reel and a YouTube video are not the same brief.
Experience onboarding clients onto a software platform.
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent.

The biggest thing we care about: O
wnership.

We want someone who doesn't wait to be told to. You notice what isn't working, come up with ideas, execute, learn from the data, and improve.

Salary:
From R5,500/month

Vald. Birn A/S, Vald. Birn A/S

Program Manager - ERP Transformation

Indtast din mailadresse, og tryk Fortsæt.

Din mailadresse

Indtast en gyldig mailadresse

Jeg giver hermed mit samtykke til, at Vald. Birn A/S, hvor jeg søger ansættelse, og Garuda AS, som fungerer som databehandler, kan indsamle og registrere de personoplysninger, jeg afgiver. Du kan læse samtykkeerklæringen ved at klikke her.

Dette felt er påkrævet.

Hvis du allerede er oprettet som ansøger til stillingen, kan du logge direkte ind her.

Samtykkeerklæring

Dataansvarlig

Vald. Birn A/S

Databehandler

Garuda

Voldbjergvej 14, 2.sal

8240 Risskov

support@garuda.dk

+45 87 46 86 00

Oplysning Om Indsamling Af Dine Personoplysninger

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.

Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.

Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.

Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.

Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.

Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.

Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.

Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.

Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

PROGRAM MANAGER - ERP TRANSFORMATION

Vil du være med til at drive en af de mest betydningsfulde digitale transformationer i BIRN Groups historie?

BIRN Group står foran implementeringen af en ny fælles ERP-platform på tværs af koncernens selskaber og forretningsområder. Samtidig skal centrale platforme og processer omkring blandt andet produktion, produktdata og master data hænge sammen med ERP-løsningen og understøtte virksomhedens behov.

Derfor søger vi nu en erfaren Program Manager, der kan sikre følgeskab, eksekvere og tage det samlede ansvar for transformationen og føre organisationen sikkert fra beslutning og design til implementering, go-live og stabil drift.

Du får en central rolle i tæt samspil med styregruppen, Group IT Manager, forretningens procesejere samt eksterne leverandører og implementeringspartnere.

Rollen refererer til Group CEO, som er formand for programmets styregruppe.

STILLINGEN

Stillingen er en projektansættelse på 2 år med mulighed for fastansættelse ved projektets afslutning.

Som Program Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for at etablere og drive BIRN Groups ERP-program. Du skaber struktur, fremdrift og tydelige beslutningsveje på tværs af arbejdsprocesser, selskaber og fagområder. Du sikrer samtidig, at mennesker, processer, data og teknologi tænkes sammen, så programmet skaber varige forretningsmæssige forbedringer.

Du leder programmets samlede leverance og skaber et konstruktivt, resultatorienteret samarbejde mellem interne nøglepersoner og eksterne partnere. En vigtig del af opgaven er at omsætte kompleksitet til klare prioriteringer og et transparent beslutningsgrundlag for styregruppe og ledelse.

DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER

Etablere og drive programmets governance, organisering, arbejdsformer og beslutningsstruktur.
Udarbejde og vedligeholde den samlede programplan med scope, milepæle, ressourcer, budget og afhængigheder.
Lede ERP-programmet fra design og implementering til go-live, stabilisering og efterfølgende udrulning på tværs af sites og selskaber.
Styre og koordinere leverandører, implementeringspartnere og øvrige eksterne rådgivere, herunder opfølgning på kontrakter og leverancer.
Sikre sammenhæng mellem ERP og centrale platforme som MES, PLM og øvrige relevante IT- og OT-løsninger i tæt samarbejde med Group IT Manager.
Koordinere Business Process Owners, Master Data Management og Change Management ind i programmets planer og leverancer.
Sikre styring af kvalitet, risici, issues, ændringer, kapacitet og tværgående afhængigheder.
Forberede og drive styregruppemøder samt udarbejde beslutningsoplæg og præcis statusrapportering til ledelsen.
Sikre fokus på business case, gevinstrealisering og organisatorisk forankring gennem hele programmet.
Opbygge og udvikle et stærkt program- og projektteam med tydeligt ansvar, høj samarbejdsevne og en leveranceorienteret kultur.

DIN BAGGRUND

Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring med komplekse transformationsprogrammer og har stået med et tilsvarende ansvar i mindst én større ERP-implementering. Det er en fordel, hvis din erfaring er opnået i en international produktions- eller industrikoncern med flere lokationer og komplekse værdikæder.

Dokumenteret erfaring med Programme Management og større ERP-implementeringer, gerne end-to-end fra design til stabil drift.
Erfaring med multi-site eller international rollout og koordinering på tværs af selskaber, geografier og forretningsenheder.
God forståelse for centrale forretningsprocesser inden for eksempelvis økonomi, indkøb, salg, produktion, logistik og supply chain.
Indsigt i platformslandskabet omkring ERP, herunder MES, PLM, integrationer samt samspillet mellem IT og OT.
Erfaring med leverandørstyring, implementeringspartnere, kommercielle aftaler og kontraktopfølgning.
Forståelse for data- og master data governance samt change management i større transformationsprogrammer.
Stærk økonomisk forståelse og erfaring med budgetstyring, business cases og gevinstrealisering.

DIG SOM PERSON

Du skaber retning og fremdrift og er tydelig, beslutsom og tillidsvækkende i din ledelsesstil.
Du kan bevæge dig sikkert mellem strategiske drøftelser, styring af komplekse leverancer og praktisk problemløsning.
Du arbejder struktureret, følger konsekvent op og formår at udfordre både organisationen og eksterne partnere konstruktivt.
Du kommunikerer klart og præcist og kan oversætte mellem teknik, proces og forretning, både i bestyrelseslokalet og tæt på driften.
Du samarbejder naturligt på tværs, deler viden og skaber ejerskab hos ledere, specialister og brugere.
Vi lægger vægt på den rette profil og er derfor åbne over for kandidater, der ønsker at indgå i rollen via eget CVR-nummer.

BIRN TILBYDER

Et klart mandat og tæt samarbejde med styregruppe, topledelse og nøglepersoner på tværs af BIRN Group.
En central og synlig rolle i et strategisk transformationsprogram med stor betydning for og indflydelse på BIRN Groups digitale fremtid.
Mulighed for at sætte retning for koncernens fremtidige processer, datafundament og digitale platforme.
Et stærkt fagligt miljø med engagerede kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af funktioner og selskaber.
Konkurrencedygtige løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, der matcher din erfaring og rollens ansvar.

OM BIRN

BIRN Group er en af Nordeuropas største støberikoncerner med koncernhovedkvarter i Holstebro og datterselskaber i Danmark, Sverige, Tyskland og Italien.

BIRN Group er udelukkende ordreproducerende og støber, overfladebehandler, bearbejder og monterer højkvalitets støbejernsprodukter til bl.a. lastbilindustrien.

Koncernen har en lang og traditionsrig virksomhedshistorie og beskæftiger omkring 700 medarbejdere, heraf ca. 500 i Holstebro. Hovedparten af produktionen afsættes internationalt.

BIRN Groups DNA udspringer fra vores passionerede medarbejdere, der samarbejder på tværs af koncernen som et fælles team, og som virksomhed og medarbejdere fremstår vi ansvarlige og ordentlige i ord og handling.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i disse værdier, og kan du hertil bidrage til fællesskabet med høj faglighed, godt humør og forandringsparathed, så er du sikkert vores ny kollega.

INTERESSERET

Så modtager vi gerne din motiverede ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt, dog senest 30/09.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Group HR Manager Morten Madsen på +45 3016 0115.

new_jobs.title: 35F Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

On the battlefield, success depends on accurate and timely intel. As an Army National Guard Intelligence Analyst, you will play a key role in the interpretation and exploitation of information gathered from or about the threat. Intelligence Analysts provide Guard personnel with information about enemy forces and potential battle areas, and use information derived from all intelligence disciplines to determine changes in enemy capabilities, vulnerabilities, and probable courses of action. You’ll gain Military Intelligence training, education, and a security clearance that could open doors to rewarding career opportunities with other intelligence agencies.

Specific duties of the Intelligence Analyst may include: preparing all-source intelligence products; providing Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Synchronization support; processing incoming reports and messages; determining the significance and reliability of incoming information; establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-referencing intelligence records and files; integrating incoming information with current intelligence holdings; and preparing and maintaining enemy situational graphics.

Job Duties

Preparing all-source intelligence products to support the combat commander
Assessing the significance and reliability of incoming intelligence collection
Establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-reference intelligence records and files

Some Of The Skills You’ll Learn

Critical thinking
The ability to use sophisticated mapping tools, intelligence networks, and systems to identify the evolving threat on the battlefield
Gather information utilizing premier digital and analytical tools to create products for the Commander

Helpful Skills

Analytical thinking; gathering information, and understanding of relevancy
Interest in reading maps and charts

More than any other branch of service, the Army National Guard offers a wide range of intelligence-related positions. Through your training, you will develop skills and experience to create opportunities for a civilian career with federal agencies like the National Security Agency.

Earn While You Learn

Instead of paying to learn these skills, get paid to learn. In the Army National Guard, you will learn these valuable job skills while earning a regular paycheck and qualifying for tuition assistance and certifications. Job training for an Intelligence Analyst consists of 10 weeks of Basic Training, where you'll learn basic Soldiering skills, and 13 weeks of Advanced Individual Training (AIT) and on-the-job instruction, including practice in intelligence gathering. You’ll learn in the classroom and gain experience in the field. Completion of your initial entry training in the Army National Guard could also lead to additional college credit.

Benefits/Requirements

Benefits

Paid training
Earn a security clearance
A monthly paycheck
Montgomery GI Bill
Federal and State tuition assistance
Retirement benefits for part-time service
Low-cost life insurance (up to $400,000 in coverage)
401(k)-type savings plan
Student Loan Repayment Program (up to $50,000, for existing loans)
Health care benefits available
VA home loans
Bonuses, if applicable

Most non-prior service candidates will initially earn between $200 and $250 per drill weekend, subject to change.

Requirements

Military enlistment in the Army National Guard
Must be at least a junior in high school, or have a high school diploma or GED certificate
Must be between the ages of 17 and 35
Must be able to pass a physical exam and meet legal and moral standards
Must meet citizenship requirements (see NATIONALGUARD.com for details)

Requires military enlistment. Programs and benefits are subject to change. Ask your Army National Guard recruiter for the most up-to-date information. Actual MOS assignment may depend on MOS availability.

new_jobs.title: Interoperability Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Zus is a shared health data platform designed to accelerate healthcare data interoperability by providing easy-to-use patient data via API, embedded components, and direct EHR integrations. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus partners with HIEs and other data networks to aggregate patient clinical history and then translates that history into user-friendly information at the point of care. Zus's mission is to catalyze healthcare's greatest inventors by maximizing the value of patient insights - so that they can build up, not around.

What We're Looking For

Every customer on the Zus network should have access to the most comprehensive clinical data possible and should understand exactly what they have. As Interoperability Operations Analyst, you'll build the metrics, intelligence, and tooling that make that possible. You'll dig into where coverage is strong and where it's thin, surface the reasons why, and partner with support and solutions teams to close the gaps. When the right fix is a query, you'll write it. When it's an automated workflow, you'll build it.

This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a SQL editor and a Python script, gets genuinely curious about unexplained patterns in data, and is excited about using AI tools to work faster and smarter. You'll sit at the intersection of data, operations, and product. Your insights will shape how the network grows and how we serve our customers

As part of our team, you will be focused on...

Coverage Intelligence
Build and maintain the metrics and dashboards that track clinical data coverage across the Zus network — by geography, network, data type, and customer
Identify coverage gaps and anomalies, investigate root causes, and communicate findings clearly to customers and internal stakeholders
Deliver the regular coverage intelligence that helps every customer understand the depth and breadth of their data — and what's driving any gaps

Operations Partnership

Work closely with support and solutions teams to translate coverage findings into operational actions — escalations, network outreach, configuration changes
Develop and maintain playbooks for recurring coverage issues, turning one-off investigations into repeatable processes
Contribute to onboarding quality by flagging patterns in new participant data that suggest connectivity or configuration problems

Tooling & Automation

Build internal tools, scripts, and automated workflows that reduce manual analysis and surface insights faster
Experiment with AI tools (including Claude) and BI platforms to accelerate how the team operates
Partner with engineering and product to ensure the systems we rely on generate the signals we need

Product Feedback Loop

Translate operational data into product requirements — if a coverage gap is systematic, you'll articulate why it's a product problem and what solving it would require
Partner with UX and engineering to shape internal and customer-facing experiences that make coverage intelligence intuitive and actionable

You're a good fit because you have...

SQL fluency: You write queries naturally and reach for them first when you have a question about data. Experience with BI tools (Looker, Metabase, Tableau, etc.) is a plus
Automation instinct: You don't accept manual work as permanent. You're comfortable in Python and curious about AI-assisted workflows — you'd rather build a system than repeat a task
Analytical curiosity: You notice when numbers don't add up and you follow the thread. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguous data and forming hypotheses
Clear communicator: You can translate a coverage analysis into a crisp, jargon-free narrative for a customer or an executive
Healthcare interest: Prior exposure to clinical data formats (FHIR, HL7, C-CDA) or the provider/EMR ecosystem is a plus, but a genuine interest in how healthcare data flows is what matters most

Why this role matters...

Data coverage is one of the most tangible levers for customer value at Zus and right now, the infrastructure for understanding and improving it is still being built. You'll have real ownership over that build: the metrics, the tooling, and the feedback loops that help the network get better over time. The work compounds.

We will offer you…

Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team a combination of cash and equity
Robust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, unlimited PTO
Opportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)

Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.

We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.

new_jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst: Data Office - Actuarial Data & Tools
new_jobs.description:
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets and manage risks.

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as Lead Business Analyst – Actuarial Commercial Lines
to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make Your Mark

General Insurance is a leading provider of insurance products and services – focused on helping to manage risk for commercial and personal customers. We offer a broad range of products through a diversified, multi-channel distribution network, including one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. The Data Office supports the overall General Insurance product by managing Data, Data Governance, and the presentation of the data (Business Intelligence Delivery).

How You Will Create An Impact

AIG is looking for a driven individual to assume a critical role within the Data Office. This role will work directly with the Actuarial and Data teams to ensure a clear understanding of data and analytics needs and priorities. In addition, the individual will hold Global Data Warehouse Product Ownership responsibilities, ensuring execution aligns with the highest business priorities and Data Office strategy, and that sunset opportunities are realized.

About The Role

The Business Analyst – Actuarial, Commercial Lines
role sits within the Global Data Office at the intersection of business strategy, data, and analytics, and works closely with Commercial Lines Actuarial Groups. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of actuarial concepts (reserving, pricing, and risk assessment), proven data and analytics capabilities, excellent communication skills, and experience as an Agile Product Owner. In this role, you will translate complex actuarial business requirements into actionable data engineering specifications by collaborating directly with data development teams. As a trusted business partner and product owner within the Global Data Warehouse, this role will help shape how AIG uses data to make better decisions, simplify its analytics landscape, and focus investments where they matter most .

Responsibilities

Business Requirements:
Lead deep, structured requirement sessions with senior actuaries to understand workflows, data nuances, and reporting needs, creating detailed functional specifications.

Stakeholder Management: Facilitate alignment across actuaries and Data Office teams on project priorities, project timelines, and management of the deliverables.
Product Owner for Data Platform & Tool Development: Develop roadmaps for actuarial data and tool development requirements and partner with data engineers to build and deploy them in timely manner.
Agile Development Leadership & Product Backlog Management
Lead Agile Ceremonies: Act as the Business Analyst Lead within an agile team, facilitating user story refinement, sprint planning, and daily scrums.
Backlog Grooming: Translate actuarial requirements (reserving, pricing, modeling) into actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria for developers.

Data Governance & Quality: Ensure compliance with data standards and maintain rigorous documentation for data lineage, testing, and production changes.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Experience: 7+ years of experience in business analysis, actuarial tool design within the insurance/financial industry.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or related field.
Actuarial Knowledge: Strong understanding of Commercial Insurance actuarial concepts (e.g., reserving methods, pricing tools)
Data Proficiency: Experience with data environments, ETL and visualization tools
Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading Agile teams and managing product backlogs.
Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications: Actuarial Credentials, actuarial exams, or deep understanding of actuarial reserving/pricing concepts.

new_jobs.description:
À propos de nous

La Caisse nationale de solidarité pour l’autonomie (CNSA), établissement public, gère depuis 2021 la nouvelle branche de la Sécurité sociale visant à soutenir l’autonomie des personnes âgées et des personnes en situation de handicap.

En charge du pilotage de la gestion du risque, elle veille à l’équilibre financier de la branche dont le budget s’élève à plus de 43 milliards d’euros. Elle assure également l’animation des acteurs territoriaux, soutient la qualité de service, favorise le développement et la transformation de l’offre et l’accès aux droits afin de garantir la continuité des parcours. Elle joue un rôle clé dans l’information du public et contribue à la recherche dans le champ de l’autonomie. Pour mener à bien ses missions, la Caisse a élaboré un ambitieux schéma directeur des systèmes d’information.

Proximité, innovation et solidarité sont au cœur de ses valeurs.

Basée en plein Paris, à 2 mn de la gare Montparnasse, la Caisse est un établissement à taille humaine. Elle propose une diversité de métiers autour de la conduite de projets, l’animation territoriale, l’expertise médico-sociale, le pilotage financier, la production de données et le déploiement de systèmes d’information…

Pour continuer à améliorer la réponse aux besoins des personnes, à leurs aidants et aux professionnels et relever les défis de la nouvelle branche de Sécurité sociale, la CNSA se transforme et recrute ! Pour plus d’informations, vous pouvez consulter notre site internet (https://www.cnsa.fr).

Mission

La CNSA souhaite renforcer ses capacités d'anticipation et de gestion du risque financier de la branche à moyen terme afin d'éclairer les décisions de la direction générale, des tutelles et des pouvoirs publics.

Pour y parvenir, le-la titulaire vient renforcer nos compétences en projections des besoins concernant le champ de l’autonomie et de développement de l’offre intégrant une dimension socio-démographique, économique et les compétences permettant une meilleure compréhension des parcours des personnes concernées en croisant les données disponibles. Ce poste est rattaché à la DPE, future direction des statistiques.

Vous prendrez en charge une partie des missions suivantes :

Développer les capacités de prévision et de projection de la caisse : produire, améliorer ou décliner à un niveau territorial approprié des analyses prospectives relatives aux besoins d'accompagnement, aux évolutions démographiques, à l'offre médico-sociale et aux trajectoires de dépenses en s’appuyant notamment sur les travaux de la DREES, de l’INSEE, des directions métiers et des partenaires ; penser d’emblée le besoin des acteurs territoriaux dans ces projections et la mise à disposition des résultats en open data
Concevoir et exploiter des modèles d'analyse : développer des modèles de projection et d'estimation des dynamiques de l'autonomie notamment sur le champ du handicap en structurant et animant un groupe de travail dédié ; réaliser des travaux de simulation et d'évaluation ex ante des impacts de réformes dans les champs non-couverts actuellement au sein de la CNSA ; exploiter les données croisées du SNDS et des systèmes d’informations de la CNSA par les techniques de data science pour comprendre les trajectoires des personnes concernées et anticiper les besoins.
Renforcer la gestion du risque et la capacité d'anticipation : identifier et analyser les principaux risques susceptibles d'affecter l'équilibre financier, l'offre de services, les besoins des publics ou la mise en œuvre des politiques publiques ; développer des approches de gestion du risque fondées sur l'analyse des données, les projections et les scénarios prospectifs ; éclairer les déterminants des dépenses et les enjeux de soutenabilité en s’appuyant sur les recherches financées par la caisse (travaux de l’IPP, de Dauphine…), sur la littérature existante ou sur les collaborations existantes ; contribuer au rapport de branche en s’appuyant sur l’ensemble de ces analyses
Diffuser les connaissances : produire des notes de synthèse, documents d'aide à la décision et éléments de prospective à destination de la direction, des cabinets ministériels et des tutelles ; valoriser les travaux réalisés dans des revues et colloques correspondant au niveau des analyses conduites ;
Assurer une veille sur les évolutions démographiques, économiques et institutionnelles susceptibles d'affecter la branche Autonomie et sur les techniques économiques ou statistiques permettant de conduire les missions décrites. Profil

Compétences Générales

Vision stratégique et sens de l'intérêt général
Curiosité intellectuelle et goût pour l'innovation méthodologique
Rigueur scientifique et esprit critique
Capacité à prendre du recul et à formuler des recommandations
Sens du collectif et aptitude à travailler en réseau
Autonomie, initiative et capacité à construire une fonction nouvelle au sein de l'établissement
Diplomatie et aisance relationnelle

Compétences Techniques

Maîtrise des méthodes de prévision statistique et de projection démographique, financière
Expérience de construction et d'exploitation de modèles d'aide à la décision
Connaissance des méthodes de microsimulation et de modélisation des comportements
Analyser les déterminants de la dépense publique et les enjeux de soutenabilité
Produire des analyses prospectives à moyen et long terme
Maîtrise des méthodes d'analyse quantitative et de traitement de données massives.
Bonne connaissance des politiques de l'autonomie, du médico-social et de la protection sociale ;

Diplôme de niveau Bac +5 en statistique, économétrie, économie, data science, mathématiques appliquées, actuariat, santé publique ou politiques publiques ou d’un doctorat, vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans les domaines de la prévision, modélisation et / ou traitement des données de masse en vue de produire des analyses approfondies, idéalement au sein d’un service statistique de la sphère publique ou de Sécurité Sociale.

INFORMATIONS COMPLEMENTAIRES

Contrat : CDI

Prise de fonction : Dès que possible

Nombre de poste à pourvoir : 1

Lieu d’affectation : 66 Avenue du Maine, 75014 Paris, à proximité immédiate de la Gare Montparnasse et accessible via le métro ligne 4, 6,12 et 13 ainsi que de nombreuses lignes de bus (28, 58, 82, 88, 89, 91, 92, 94, 95 et 96)

new_jobs.description:
Description -

We are seeking a detail-oriented and driven Systems Program Manager
to lead program development and product launches. This role is responsible for coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines, and ensuring that products and programs are successfully brought to market. The Systems Program Manager will play a critical role in bridging product, engineering, operations, and go-to-market teams to deliver high-quality launches on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of product and program launches from concept through release.
Define and manage program scope, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
Partner with product management, engineering, marketing, operations, and supply chain to ensure launch readiness.
Track and manage dependencies, risks, and issues to keep launches on track.
Facilitate cross-functional meetings, communicate updates, and maintain program documentation.
Ensure alignment between development teams and business requirements.
Monitor progress, escalate challenges, and drive timely resolutions.
Support post-launch reviews and continuous improvement for future programs.
Standardize and optimize processes, tools, and templates to improve launch efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in program management, project management, or product launch roles.
Proven success managing cross-functional products or program launches in a large organization.
Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.
Excellent communication skills, including executive reporting and stakeholder alignment.
Experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar).
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Certifications

PMP, CSM, or equivalent project/program management certification a plus.
Lean Six Sigma or process improvement certification a plus.
Familiarity with HP product development and launch processes is strongly preferred.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
Opportunity to lead impactful products and program launches.
Professional development and career growth.
Collaborative and innovative workplace

new_jobs.title: Digital Transformation Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Digital Transformation is a multi-year enterprise initiative focused on standardizing business processes, creating a digital core, improving data quality, enabling AI-driven insights, and deploying scalable technology platforms across the organization. Key initiatives include Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and enterprise data modernization efforts.

The impact you’ll make

The Digital Transformation (DT) Program Manager will lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and related business process modernization. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs from planning through deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation roadmaps, and enterprise architecture standards.

The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. The role requires strong program leadership, business process expertise, stakeholder management, change leadership, and execution excellence in a global environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead programs in our digital transformation initiative related to projects to solve complex business problems.
Build solutions that will improve business processes and support critical business strategies.
Provide actionable insights for management to influence decision making through data collection and analysis.
Develop and deliver clear and concise communications for leadership teams and stakeholders.
Ensure execution, manage risks, assure adherence to program or project schedules, and performance to meet business requirements.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process.
Run change management for projects and programs and support proper project closure.

Minimum Qualifications

Who we’re looking for

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or related field with 10+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 8+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.
8+ years of related experience in project management or program management
Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders.
Advanced analytical skills to interpret and utilize data for decision support.

Preferred Qualifications

Semiconductor industry or global supplier experience is a plus.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
